The '''QueTee model''' was a small, rectangular model of [[computer access droid]] about the size of a standard suitcase.> The QueTee's face was covered with several blinking lights, screens of various sizes, and input and output jacks. These droids were capable of communicating in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="BI" />
